prompt:
Use case: logo-brand.
Asset type: a single polished concept board containing FOUR new mobile app icon proposals for oneBeat, a playful app for walking in groups to a synchronized musical beat.
Primary request: Produce ONE square image, ideally 1536x1536, with a precise TWO BY TWO grid. The four icons must be FOUR DIFFERENT designs, not recolors, and each icon area must itself be a perfect SQUARE. Use uniform size, generous equal spacing and a quiet warm-ivory presentation background. Number the concepts 04, 05, 06, 07 in small crisp dark type BELOW their respective icon squares, outside the art. No other text.
Established app language: bold near-black #171B1F hand-inked comic contours; warm cream #FFF9EE, coral #FF7056, teal #29B5AE, pale lavender #C5B7EB, blue #A9C9F2, golden yellow. Flat confident shapes, a hint of paper grain, witty friendly indie illustration. Strong silhouettes that remain readable at small icon size. No glossy 3D, no photography, no thin fiddly details.
Top left, concept 04 — SAME BEAT TOGETHER: two simple abstract walking companions in profile, leaning forward and stepping in the same direction, one cream and one coral, large friendly round heads and extremely simplified chunky legs, visually sharing one large rhythmic ground dash. On a full lavender square background. The pair forms one memorable compact emblem. No sneaker closeups, no crowded crowd, no detailed faces.
Top right, concept 05 — GROOVING CACTUS: a lively simple cactus mascot nodding to the app's current cactus identity, three bold curved green/teal cactus arms arranged with the energy of a dancing character, one raised arm subtly shaped like a musical note, just two dot eyes and a tiny happy mouth. A single coral beat spark. Full warm cream square background. No pot, no desert scene, no spines field, no tiny hatching.
Bottom left, concept 06 — SAME FREQUENCY: one striking pair of chunky cream headphones forming a rounded arch, inside it a simple CORAL waveform with just three strong rhythmic pillars, constructed as one unified mark. Thick near-black outlines and teal accent pads, full sky-blue square background. Make it warm comic brand illustration, not a generic tech-company vector. No microphones, no play triangle, no letters.
Bottom right, concept 07 — RHYTHM PATH: a bold continuous coral ribbon path stepping diagonally upward, with three clearly spaced cream rectangular beat marks integrated into it, the whole silhouette subtly suggesting forward motion and the number ONE without literal type. A very small pale-yellow star-like beat accent at the leading end. Full teal square background. Very simple graphic, optimistic walking adventure feeling; no scenery, no road perspective vanishing point, no shoes, no metronome.
Composition constraints: FOUR perfect square icon tiles, square corners, full-bleed colored backgrounds, no pre-rounded corners, no fake phone screens, no app labels within icons. Main emblem of each inside its central ~70–75% area, plenty of color-only margin for future OS masking. Four tiles consistent visual weight and borderless full backgrounds. This is a finished high-quality concept comparison board, not a wireframe or collage of previous assets. None should repeat the previous shoes pair, teal metronome, or lamp portrait. Exactly four new concepts with the specified 04/05/06/07 numbering below. No watermark or signature.
